how_each_number_was_obtained: Ran the pinned binary against the committed archive and parsed its stdout. Degrees are the reference's own rendering at six decimal places, so a comparison against them is a comparison at 1e-6.
what_this_is: What `pmtiles show <archive>` prints for each committed golden, field by field. header.json carries the fields go-pmtiles' DeserializeHeader returns; this carries the ones it renders, which is where bounds, centre, tile type and the two compressions become observable. Those are exactly the fields no test read back, so a big-endian i32 or a lat/lon transposition was invisible.
